name: OpenCode
description: Your coding agent in the browser, with projects, terminals and your choice of models.
changes: First catalog release: native browser UI, persistent projects, workspace access and managed provider keys.
notes: Workspace members who can open the app share access to its projects, terminal and connected providers.
Keep a browser tab open while an agent works. Running tasks stop when the sandbox parks.
Model usage is billed separately by your provider.
